data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 shares mechanism with SRC_005: both mechanisms depend on a hidden synchronizing cause—extreme value statistics in SRC_003 and market signals in SRC_005—that induces correlated failures across 'independent' nodes while masking the correlation from observers. Refuted if the heavy-tailed distribution of catastrophic shared causes in SRC_003 operates independently of operator optimization behavior, meaning failures would correlate identically even if operators used diverse, non-convergent scaling algorithms.
